content.short: Ankr is a Web3 development hub offering high-performance RPC connections to 30+ blockchains and global node infrastructure.
content.description: Ankr provides high-performance RPC API connections to 30+ blockchains, backed by a global network of node infrastructure. Designed for developers, it offers a suite of advanced tools and services, including Web3 SDKs, libraries, NFT APIs, and wallet connection utilities, to streamline building Web3 apps. With nodes distributed worldwide, it delivers reliable, scalable blockchain access to power decentralized applications with speed and confidence.
